body:
**Describe the bug**
There is code in 5.2.4 (JoinVerticesProcess.cpp) which is causing animation weight mapping issues and thus tearing during animation This only happens in files 5.2.4-current but does not happen in 5.2.3 or before (tested right back to 4.x)

[5.2.4-current](https://i.imgur.com/9OHw9Ar.png)

And working state

[4.1-5.2.3](https://i.imgur.com/8WRsFof.png)

**To Reproduce**
Compile 5.2.4 release and animate a typical clothing mesh from Marvelous Designer (without retop) with Mixamo animations
Also can be seen in 5.2.4 Assimp Viewer to disprove user code error.
Compile 5.2.3 and see difference.

**Expected behavior**
Expected to see clean weight skinning 

**Platform (please complete the following information):**
 - Windows 10
 
**Additional context**
A lot of code went on since 5.2.3 in the join vertices and I am unable to isolate exactly what or where it is but this does cause big problems, a quick and dirty fix is to replace the JoinVerticesProcess.cpp 5.2.4 file with 5.2.3 which gets us going again.

Likely `use unordered_set to accelerate the vertix merging` is the reason. See: https://github.com/assimp/assimp/commit/0ffb91fbf15921582552ab7b4fca5eaa3aa0150f by @motazmuhammad 

Dear @motazmuhammad I think your intentions are good and didn't mean to break the code but I don't think it was fully tested, can you please check this issue and resolve it, thank you.
